headline: On-demand threshold: SER kill line hit (side ~5,858 under 13k, holders 55 under 80) — Pass. Grumpy Walrus since 12:15 PM bought ~53.7k NIGHT (~13.2k ADA), sold 3M SNEK (~8.1k ADA), ~4.07M MEPE (~2.6k ADA), 3k ASCEND (~3.2k ADA; bag ~305k) and 1M SOLADA (~1.9k ADA); COCK clips ~54k; net ADA ~+1,034. ASCEND side ~1.149M (53.2% above). No SER sells by Grumpy. No SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: SER crossed both the 13k pool line and the 80-holder line with zero Grumpy SER sells, so the third kill clause stayed dark while the first two alone were enough for Pass.
